reasons.gameplay: Recovery progression, timed coils and deck defense provided understandable variation and pressure. Route completion was heavily assisted, so exploration and sustained manual combat enjoyment remain unassessed.

reasons.usability: Contextual hold labels, map route and explicit assist accounting are helpful; threat cue handling and attention competition create friction.
reasons.readability: Large key controls and coil states read well; small signage, condensed prompts and muted enemies against gray structures are harder at 844x390.
